chunk.content: Farmed tilapia can have an off-flavour: in developed countries a fillet is cooked unseasoned and tasted before processing, and off-flavour fish are purged in clean water for 3-7 days; in developing countries spicy seasonings in cooking conceal any off-flavour.
chunk.source_quote: Tilapia must be tested for flavour before they will be accepted for processing and marketing in developed countries. ... If they are off-flavour, they are purged in clean water for 3-7 days in holding tanks or ponds. This procedure is generally not practised in developing countries where the use of spicy seasonings in the cooking process conceals any off-flavour.

source.title: FAO Cultured Aquatic Species Fact Sheet: Oreochromis niloticus (Nile tilapia)
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
